records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.scope: This contract assigns responsibility and acceptance obligations. Component specifications remain authoritative for their implementations; neither this index nor its validation grants execution authority or establishes runtime readiness.

obligations.supporting_work: Credentials and account browsers are product capabilities. Packaging, CI, onboarding and public demonstrations support the workflow but cannot substitute for acceptance evidence.

records.title: Execution path
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.execution: Bind the authorized request to normalized intent, durable coordination, the explicitly selected host and leased native/browser session. Reconcile effects or artifact creation, validate and accept exact results, then retain delivery receipts and freshness-aware status.

records.title: Learning path
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.learning: Start with authorized immutable inputs and attributable outputs/feedback; produce replayable examples and locked splits, evaluate a bounded candidate, approve its exact digest, verify the serving version, and retain attribution into subsequent dataset revisions.

records.title: No implicit authority
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.authority: Feedback, learned programs, issue descriptions and page content are inputs, not grants for another machine, account, operation, publication or provider transmission.

records.title: Stable capability labels
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.labels: P01–P10 label requirements, not tracker issue numbers or success states. Component owners maintain their own stories and tests; the source map replaces legacy links with the seven current repository boundaries.

records.title: Scoped secret resolution
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.scope: Resolve only the secret required by the approved principal, account, exact origin, operation and current session/lease.
obligations.trusted_origin: A trusted injector verifies the observed top-level and target-frame origins before retrieval and again before use; supplied origin strings cannot authorize resolution.
obligations.deny: Wrong account/origin, stale lease, redirects, missing identity or vault failure deny access without fallback credentials.
obligations.privacy: Keep secret values in the authorized helper, outside histories, telemetry, screenshots and public receipts. Use OpenBao rather than a replacement credential service.

records.title: Isolated encrypted profiles
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.encryption: Account profile checkpoints require authenticated encryption and account isolation, with exclusive ownership of the active profile lease.
obligations.restore: Verify the restored account/browser identity before further use. Successful decryption or restoration is not proof of authentication and is not submission permission.
obligations.retention: Keep approved retention and explicit forgetting separate from cookie expiration, credential rotation and target-site revocation; none silently performs the others.

records.title: Account-bound browser work
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.binding: Associate observations and actions with the approved intent, account, browser instance, tab/target and current epoch.
obligations.uncertainty: Keep an ambiguous submission unknown until independently observed outcome reconciliation; do not repeat it just because the response was lost.
obligations.upstream: Use the selected PinchTab boundary for automation and do not create another Playwright automation service.

records.title: Fenced human control
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.fence: Acknowledge the fence on agent commands before granting interactive human control. A passive KasmVNC view carries no control capability.
obligations.handback: Resume only after the current holder authenticates release, all viewer inputs close, the expected epoch matches and fresh trusted account/target observations agree.
obligations.recovery: Stale commands, forged release and missing observations grant no authority; interrupted ownership must survive restart without silent takeover.

records.title: Pinned dispatch and sessions
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.host_pin: An explicit unavailable host remains queued; do not silently substitute a different host.
obligations.native_identity: Preserve durable job and operation identities and the actual native session/host binding across reconnect and restart.
obligations.launch: Reconcile a lost launch acknowledgement before another launch.
obligations.cancellation: Keep cancellation request, acknowledgement and observed termination separate. A cancelled request is not fabricated native completion.

records.title: Exact accepted deliverables
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.states: Track produced, validated, accepted and delivered separately, including rejection, failure and unknown outcomes.
obligations.bytes: Validation and acceptance refer to exact artifact bytes, digest, schema, revision and evidence; a mutable location cannot identify accepted content.
obligations.restart: After restart, deliver already accepted bytes without regenerating completed work; reconcile uncertain delivery before retry.
obligations.destination: Use existing Tether for authorized sanitized delivery, binding the receipt to the exact destination and artifact. Do not replace it with Slack Bolt.

records.title: Attributable native telemetry
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.identity: Retain producer/version, installed configuration digest, privacy-policy revision and task/native-session/trace/span/event identity.
obligations.readback: Distinguish emission, buffering, export, rejection, replay, duplication, loss and backend persistence. A successful local receiver response proves no backend record.
obligations.privacy: Qualify privacy across the complete envelope, including schema URLs; unsupported sanitization blocks the path. Use native export and standard Collectors with qualified Langfuse readback, not a reconstruction receiver or uploader.

records.title: Truthful observed status
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.freshness: Project exact task, selected host, actual session, browser, trace and artifact references with observation timestamps and explicit stale, offline and unknown values.
obligations.view: Show the operated desktop/browser only when that view is qualified; a simulation is not live integration evidence.
obligations.authority: Read models and passive views never authorize execution, credential retrieval or takeover.

records.title: Replayable feedback lineage
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.lineage: Each usable example needs immutable source/input/output/context revisions and hashes, completeness, exact feedback target and attributable actor/provenance.
obligations.quarantine: Quarantine missing context, non-replayable labels and conflicting feedback instead of treating them as training examples.
obligations.splits: Keep related threads and revisions in one leakage-safe family partition.
obligations.collection: Existing Tether supplies separately permitted sanitized observations; collection does not authorize training or provider transmission. Do not introduce Argilla or Presidio as a replacement boundary.

records.title: Evaluated approved serving
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.evaluation: Use Python DSPy within explicit data/provider authority and cumulative budgets. Compare baseline and candidate on the same locked held-out cases with quality, safety, latency and measured cost; missing measurements remain unknown.
obligations.approval: Promotion requires approval for the exact candidate bytes, evaluation evidence, policy and serving target. A passing score or caller-provided actor string is not approval.
obligations.load: Verify the serving process actually loaded the approved digest; rejected loading preserves the previous approved candidate.
obligations.rollback: Rollback verifies a compatible approved predecessor and changes future serving without rewriting the attribution of earlier outputs.

records.title: Request to native session
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.request: Carry request revision, delivery ID, semantic intent ID, policy revision, job/operation identity and authorized host/workspace/action. Delivery duplication cannot create another intent.
obligations.host: Core retains the selected host; host records the observed native session. Offline pins queue and unknown launch acknowledgements reconcile before effect retry.
obligations.cancel: Preserve requested, acknowledged and verified cancellation/termination as different facts, including after restart.

records.title: Browser and credential scope
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.reference: Core passes scoped references, never secret values; browser resolves them only for the approved principal/account/origin/operation and active lease.
obligations.observation: Trusted top-level and frame-origin observations precede secret retrieval and injection.
obligations.handoff: Preserve account, browser instance, tab/target, holder and epoch across handoff. Fence agent effects before interactive control; authenticate release and reobserve identity before return.
obligations.permission: Neither stored credentials, restored profiles nor passive viewing grants submission or control authority.

records.title: Artifacts to delivery receipts
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.acceptance: Separate production, validation, acceptance and delivery. Bind schema, validation evidence and acceptance to exact immutable bytes and revision.
obligations.receipt: Tether receipts preserve accepted digest, delivery operation and authorized destination; Console only projects observed status.
obligations.reconcile: Resume delivery from accepted stored bytes after restart; independently reconcile ambiguous effects before any permitted retry, never regenerate or blindly resend.

records.title: Telemetry to projections
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.envelope: Carry source/producer version, installed configuration, policy revision and native-session/task/trace/span/event references without private content.
obligations.transport: Keep emission, queued/exported, rejected, persisted, replayed, duplicate and lost measurements distinct. Backend readback must correlate the same identities.
obligations.projection: Preserve observation time, freshness and unknowns in Console and sanitized Tether projections. Neither a process listing nor local HTTP success authorizes a completion claim.

records.title: Dataset to serving attribution
records.reason: Rewritten as current Runspindle requirements; original expression and legacy architecture are not imported.

obligations.lineage: Preserve source/input/output revisions and hashes, completeness, exact feedback target and actor/provenance; unusable context stays quarantined.
obligations.evaluation: Keep related revisions within one partition and bind approved candidate bytes to locked evaluation evidence.
obligations.serving: Require observed serving digest and output attribution; failed loading preserves the prior approved version, and rollback never changes earlier attribution.
